Rewards Terms & Conditions

HomeRewards Terms & Conditions
html:
1. Membership

Atlas Longevity Rewards is a free loyalty and referral programme available to eligible customers aged 18 or older.

Each customer may hold one rewards account.

Membership and rewards are subject to applicable laws, product eligibility and programme conditions.

2. Welcome Reward

Eligible new members receive a one-time Rp 50,000 welcome reward.

The welcome reward:

  • Is issued once per eligible customer.
  • Does not expire.
  • Cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash.
  • Cannot be combined with another coupon.
  • Applies only to eligible purchases.

3. Earning Reward Credits

Members earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent on qualifying purchases.

Credits are calculated on eligible product spending after discounts, excluding shipping and taxes.

Fractional credits are rounded down to whole credits per completed order.

Credits are issued after the qualifying order is completed.

4. Redeeming Reward Credits

250 Reward Credits may be exchanged for a Rp 250,000 discount.

The minimum eligible order value for redemption is Rp 2,500,000 before applying the shopping reward discount.

A maximum of 250 credits may be redeemed per order.

Only one shopping reward redemption is permitted per order.

Unused credits remain in the member’s account.

Credits earned from the current order cannot be redeemed against that same order.

5. Reward Expiry

Earned Reward Credits do not expire.

Issued welcome and referral rewards also do not expire.

Rewards cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred between customers.

6. Refer a Friend Programme

Members may share a unique referral link with genuine new customers.

The referred customer receives Rp 250,000 OFF their first qualifying order of at least Rp 3,000,000 before discounts.

Once the referred customer’s qualifying order is completed, the referring member receives a Rp 250,000 discount reward.

Additional genuine qualifying referrals may earn additional rewards.

Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and artificial transactions are prohibited.

An order cannot generate both a customer referral acquisition reward and an affiliate acquisition commission.

7. One Coupon Per Order

Only one coupon or promotional discount code may be used per order.

Shopping reward coupons, referral coupons, welcome coupons and other promotional codes cannot be combined.

Customers must select which available coupon they wish to use.

8. Refunds and Cancellations

Cancelled, unpaid or fraudulent orders do not qualify for rewards.

Credits awarded on fully refunded orders may be reversed.

Credits on partially refunded orders may be recalculated.

Referral rewards may be reversed if the qualifying order is refunded or becomes ineligible.

Redeemed credits may be restored following cancellation or refund where appropriate.

9. Product Eligibility

Rewards are available only on eligible products and qualifying transactions.

Some products may be excluded due to legal, regulatory or programme restrictions.

10. Fraud Prevention

Atlas Longevity may investigate duplicate accounts, self-referrals, artificial transactions and reward misuse.

Invalid or fraudulently obtained rewards may be reversed in accordance with applicable law.

11. Programme Changes

Atlas Longevity may update or discontinue the programme with appropriate notice and subject to applicable laws.

Validly earned rewards will not be removed solely because of account inactivity.

12. Customer Support

For questions regarding rewards, credits or referrals, please contact Atlas Longevity through our official website:

https://peptidesbali.online/

Final terms require legal review before publication.
